description: This file contains an abstract implementation of a Data Access Object (DAO) for managing entities in a JPA context within the SalesManager framework. It provides generic CRUD operations such as get, save, update, delete, list, and count for entity classes extending SalesManagerEntity.

classes.name: SalesManagerEntityDaoImpl
classes.description: A generic DAO implementation providing basic CRUD operations for entities extending SalesManagerEntity, utilizing JPA entity management.

methods.name: SalesManagerEntityDaoImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class type of the entity using reflection utilities.

methods.description: Returns the Class object of the entity type managed by this DAO.

methods.description: Retrieves an entity by class type and identifier.

methods.description: Retrieves an entity by its identifier.

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Retrieves an entity based on a specified attribute and value.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an entity in the persistence context.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the state of an entity from the database.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all entities of the managed class.

methods.description: Lists entities filtered by a specific attribute value.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists entities with filtering, ordering, and pagination support.
